name: limits-window-and-getters
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org does not expose the exercised Limit window getters; retained as local limits evidence and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: @isTest private class LimitsWindowFixtureTest { @isTest static void restoresParentWindowAndReportsGetters() { insert new Account(Name = 'parent'); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getDmlStatements()); System.assertEquals(150, Limits.getLimitDmlStatements()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getDmlRows()); System.assertEquals(10000, Limits.getLimitDmlRows()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getQueries()); System.assertEquals(100, Limits.getLimitQueries()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getQueryRows()); System.assertEquals(50000, Limits.getLimitQueryRows()); System.assert(Limits.getHeapSize() >= 0); System.assertEquals(6291456, Limits.getLimitHeapSize()); System.assert(Limits.getCpuTime() > 0); System.assertEquals(10000, Limits.getLimitCpuTime()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getCallouts()); System.assertEquals(100, Limits.getLimitCallouts()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getAsyncJobs()); System.assertEquals(50, Limits.getLimitAsyncJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getFutureCalls()); System.assertEquals(50, Limits.getLimitFutureCalls()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getQueueableJobs()); System.assertEquals(50, Limits.getLimitQueueableJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getBatchJobs()); System.assertEquals(5, Limits.getLimitBatchJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getScheduledJobs()); System.assertEquals(100, Limits.getLimitScheduledJobs()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); System.assertEquals(10, Limits.getLimitEmailInvocations()); Test.startTest(); insert new Account(Name = 'child'); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage email = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); email.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'hello@example.test'}); email.setPlainTextBody('hello'); Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{email}); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getDmlStatements()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getDmlStatements()); System.assertEquals(0, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); } }
